summary: A multi office Sydney family and property firm with 100 plus Google reviews is a strength, but placeholder text, mismatched links and no inline form appear to cost you enquiries.

findings.problem: A heading appears to read 'Add Your Heading Text Here', Parramatta appears spelled 'Paramatta', and the footer appears to read 'Quick LInks'.
findings.cost: Leftover template text and typos make a law firm look careless to a client choosing a lawyer.

findings.problem: The footer link 'Commercial and Litigation' appears to go to an unfair dismissal page, and wills and divorce links appear to use two different addresses.
findings.cost: Clients land on the wrong service page and leave.
findings.fix: Matching labels and one address per service.

findings.problem: The FAQ section appears to show unfinished answers such as 'I cannot provide a factual answer on whether you can contest a will'.
findings.cost: Unfinished answers lower trust and give visitors no help.
findings.fix: Real answers written by your lawyers.

findings.problem: The page appears to say both six and seven offices, 102 and 104 reviews, and no inline contact form appears, only links to a contact page.
findings.cost: Mixed numbers weaken credibility, and extra clicks lose enquiries.
findings.fix: Consistent figures and a short enquiry form on every page.

redesign: Real FAQs, consistent figures and an inline enquiry form.
